title: Field-usability test with a responder/newcomer
context: Before declaring a pack delivered it must be trialed in a real or simulated first-contact so usability problems are caught and fixed. This task records that field-usability test. It depends on the partner-priority translated set.
objective: Run and document a field-usability test of the pack with a responder and/or newcomer.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one responder and/or newcomer trials the pack in a real or simulated first-contact
Usability findings recorded (legibility, find-time, pictogram comprehension, fold/format)
Any blocking issues fixed before delivery
Findings feed the delivery record and PLAN success metrics
